images.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: rehabilitation exercise demonstration photograph, single posture, action 143 T-AXU-021 step s01.
Input images: images 1, 2 and 3 are supporting identity, clothing, studio background and photographic style references of the same adult East Asian woman. They are not exercise pose references. Repose this same woman while faithfully preserving her face, age impression, skin tone, physique and black ponytail, fitted plain white short sleeve shirt and charcoal full-length pants.
Primary request: full-body realistic photograph of this woman standing stably on a flat non-slip studio floor in a SHALLOW split stance and holding ONE small plain dark gray kettlebell with both hands close against the lower sternum. Chest and pelvis face straight forward in the neutral starting posture. Her own LEFT foot is modestly forward, her own RIGHT foot modestly back. The two feet retain clear side-to-side hip-width separation: not on a tightrope, not crossed. Both soles stably supported, knees softly bent only a little, no deep lunge or squat. Both kneecaps and toes face forward with no rotation. Upright neutral trunk, relaxed shoulders; elbows bent and near ribs; both hands grip the sides of the kettlebell handle in a realistic goblet hold, round bell below the handle resting close to the sternum, not at arm's length.
Scene/backdrop: seamless pale gray-blue studio backdrop and floor, soft natural contact shadows.
Style/medium: high-quality natural photorealistic educational studio photograph matching the references; neutral soft diffuse light, natural anatomy.
Composition/framing: portrait 4:5, fixed full-body front view with just a slight 10-degree oblique angle, camera at lower chest level, normal lens perspective; entire head, both hands, entire feet and contact shadows in frame with useful margins. The modest front/back foot stagger and lateral width should both be readily visible. Woman fills about 80% of frame height.
Text: none.
Constraints: one woman, one single posture, one kettlebell; natural proportions, anatomically accurate connected limbs and fingers. Entire feet visible, consistent gray athletic trainers with neutral plain styling. No print, no captions, no arrows, no numbers, no inset, no collage, no watermark, no extra equipment, no deep lunge, no chest rotation at this first step, no heavy weight markings. This is a stable static split-stance version only.

visual_inspection.posture: 静态浅分腿、胸口与骨盆同向朝前的中立起点
visual_inspection.direction: 中立；画面右脚为人物本人左前脚，画面左脚为本人右后脚
checks: 完整头、手、双脚及地面接触可见。
双脚有前后错步并保留清楚横向宽度，无窄直线或交叉步位；没有深蹲或深弓步。
膝盖方向跟随足尖，骨盆和胸口处于中立相对关系。
一只深灰壶铃由双手握柄，屈肘靠近胸口，没有伸臂远举。
人物、黑马尾、白短袖、深灰长裤、柔光灰蓝背景与参考相符；比例自然。
无文字、编号、箭头、拼图、水印或多余器械。

images.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational, precise-object-edit.
Asset type: rehabilitation demonstration photograph, action 143 T-AXU-021 step s02.
Input image: the sole image is the EDIT TARGET, the already accepted neutral starting photo s01. Preserve it with high fidelity.
Primary request: change ONLY the upper trunk, shoulders, bent elbows, hands, kettlebell and naturally accompanying head to show a small controlled chest rotation toward the woman's OWN LEFT. The direction is toward the RIGHT SIDE OF THE IMAGE, becoming slightly more of a right-facing profile. Rotate the chest/shoulder girdle only about 20 degrees farther toward image right relative to the unchanged pelvis, a visibly small and comfortable range. The chest-mounted kettlebell and both hands travel together with the chest and remain CLOSE AGAINST THE LOWER STERNUM. Elbows stay bent near the ribs; no reach away from chest. Natural anatomy, no extreme twist, no torso lean or side bend.
Invariants: keep EXACT same woman and face identity, black ponytail, plain white short sleeve top, charcoal pants, gray shoes, small dark gray kettlebell design, studio background, diffuse light, ground shadows, camera position, focal length, subject scale, framing and image dimensions. Keep the ENTIRE PELVIS AND EVERYTHING BELOW THE WAIST visually unchanged: same stance, front foot and back foot at the same pixel positions, same toe directions, same both sole contacts, same knee bend and knee directions, same hip/pelvis orientation. The image-right left foot remains forward, image-left right foot remains back with lateral width. Both feet supported on flat floor. No step, no pivot, no turning either knee, no deeper lunge. All feet and head fully in frame.
Text: none. Single woman and single posture only. No labels, arrows, diagrams, inset, collage or watermark.

visual_inspection.posture: 脚位不变，胸口小幅向本人左转，双手壶铃随胸
visual_inspection.direction: 本人左，朝画面右侧；相对s01肩线、胸前铃位置转向画面右
checks: 与s01机位、构图、人物尺度、衣着、灰鞋和壶铃外观相同。
前后脚位置、支撑点和足尖方向视觉保持一致；膝部不追随转胸转向。
胸部、肩和持铃双手共同向画面右小幅转动，胸铃仍近身体；无跨步、深弓步或伸臂甩铃。
骨盆位置与下肢方向大致稳定。
完整头手脚仍可见，握持合理，人体比例自然。
